objective: 최신 main 기준 실제 플레이, 문제 수정, 테마별 동일 기준 평가, 평균 90점 이상

scoring.kind: evidence-backed reviewer assessment, not a measured player satisfaction score
rules: Use the same dimensions and weights before and after fixes.
Score only after the listed representative cases have evidence; untested themes remain null.
Behavior: the intended player action reaches its result without a blocker or extra workaround.
Clarity: current state, available action, result and next step are readable at desktop and phone sizes.
Feel: feedback, pacing and visual consistency assessed during play, with explicit subjective limitations.
Robustness: cancellation, retry, reload, old-save and boundary cases preserve items and progress.
Cost: no avoidable repeated input or observable stalls; performance claims require measurements.
The final average requires all six themes, no known progress/data-loss blocker, and final regression checks.
Early-game or synthetic-fixture results cannot establish late-loop balance or player enjoyment.
